eval: (() => { const own = {'Bot Ace': 300, 'Bot Blitz': 300}; const out = {}; for (const p of dp.view.players.values()) { if (!p.bot || !p.alive) continue; const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tags .tag3d')].find((t) => t.firstChild.textContent === p.name); if (!el) continue; const shown = parseFloat(el.children[1].firstChild.style.width); const of = own[p.name] ?? 100; out[p.name] = {hp: p.hp, of, barShown: Math.round(shown), barExpected: Math.round((100 * p.hp) / of), ok: Math.abs(shown - (100 * p.hp) / of) < 1.5}; } return JSON.stringify({healthTags: out}); })()
